verdict.rationale: Cline documents autonomous headless execution in CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/GitLab), auto-commit with per-task worktrees on its Kanban board, and full file/command control with diff review — building blocks for an issue-to-PR pipeline. However, there is no explicit documented feature for pulling a tracked issue (e.g. GitHub Issues) and generating/opening a pull request end-to-end; this must be assembled by the user via scripting/CI rather than being a first-party turnkey workflow. Missing for 10: dedicated issue-import capability, native PR-creation/submission feature, and any hands-on account of a full issue→PR run.
